intro: Your bedroom should feel like a sanctuary, and Alina is designed to make it just that. Blending warmth, practicality, and durability, it keeps your essentials close, adding a touch of elegance.

features.title: Storage that fits your life
features.text: Includes an open shelf and a drawer, providing ample space to keep essentials neatly organised and within easy reach.

features.title: Built to last, just like your cherished moments
features.text: Made from high-quality engineered wood, it’s designed to endure daily use while retaining its elegance and functionality.

features.title: Perfectly compact, surprisingly spacious
features.text: A thoughtfully designed structure that fits effortlessly into cosy bedrooms while offering generous storage for your essentials.

features.title: A warm finish that feels like home
features.text: Finished in a rich, warm tone that complements any decor, adding a touch of sophistication to your bedroom.

features.title: Easy setup, because your time matters
features.text: Delivered with an easy-to-follow assembly guide, making setup quick and effortless for immediate use.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
